script.text: The final battle of the semi-finals was Vetrix vs. Kite.
Vetrix was too much for Kite, and he lost the battle.
You are beaten!
This duel is mine... as are your soul and Number Cards!
The World Duel Carnival finals were about to begin!
Duel fans, it all comes down to this! The battle you've been waiting for!
The ultimate throwdown in the first-ever World Duel Carnival!
A sizzling series of blockbuster battles have eliminated all challengers. And now only two dazzling duelists remain.
Now these dueling dynamos will go head-to-head to determine who will become the very first World Duel Carnival Champion!
I'm not surprised you made it this far, Yuma.
Yeah? Why's that?
Because of the example set for you by your dear deluded father.
When I was lost between dimensions, I sometimes gave up hope. And I would think of Kazuma, his belief in friendship and never giving up.
But Faker betrayed me, so I knew your father was wrong. Friendship isn't precious. No, not by a long shot.
But your father was right about never giving up. And now, revenge is my only reason for living. I promise you I'll never give up until I get it.
You're wrong about revenge and you're wrong about friendship.
Your son Trey is my friend, and I promised to battle to save his family. So I'm not just here to save them. Vetrix, I'm here to save you.
You're going to save me...from what?
From revenge.
It's like a poison that will only wind up destroying you!
Can you really judge me so harshly, Yuma? Don’t you think your father wants you to get revenge on Dr. Faker too?
No, I don't!
I’m ready to duel!
